title: Church Unity
definition: Church Unity is the Spirit-given oneness of believers in Christ that must be guarded through truth, humility, love, and peace.
summary: Church Unity is the Gospel-created oneness believers are called to guard through humility, truth, patience, and love.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reconciles believers to God and to one another, making one new people by His cross.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church unity is the shared life believers have in Christ through one Gospel, one Spirit, one faith, and one Lord. Scripture calls the church to preserve unity, not manufacture it through shallow agreement.

This unity does not erase truth or ignore sin. It is a Spirit-given bond that must be guarded through humility, patience, forgiveness, and love.

Jesus prayed for His people's unity and created one new people through His cross. The church's unity bears witness to Him when it is rooted in truth and love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because division can make the Gospel appear small and powerless, while false unity can hide serious error. Biblical unity protects both truth and love in the life of the church.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue peace without sacrificing truth. Refuse gossip, pride, and factionalism, and practice patience, forgiveness, and honest conversation for the sake of Christ's name.
